title: 交叉小步横移
description: 水粉表现低位横移中的小幅交叉步，点位与身体关系清楚。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original gouache illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult making a modest crossed-foot adjustment on a low traverse. Rounded cobalt handholds follow a horizontal line across a near-vertical wall, while small but clearly drawn footholds sit just above the continuous crash mat. The trailing foot moves across to a nearby step as the supporting hand stays steady; avoid tangled limbs or exaggerated twisting. Use a three-quarter medium-wide camera that reveals the route ahead and the entire empty landing zone. Paint crisp matte shapes, coral wall planes, and focused adult expression. The scene shows controlled technique, with no leap, dangerous height, lettering, or logos.
